restrictions: No force-field source has yet been accepted.
No parameters or charges are assigned.
No minimization, MD or QM calculation is authorized.
The literature audit must use primary articles, official documentation or original parameter repositories.

search_matrix.exclusion_criteria: Rigid sheets, dummy atoms, topology-only models
search_matrix.query: "hexagonal boron nitride" flexible force field molecular dynamics B N bond angle dihedral
search_matrix.required_evidence: Primary article plus complete parameter table or repository

search_matrix.exclusion_criteria: Models validated only for flat h-BN without curvature analysis
search_matrix.query: "boron nitride nanotube" force field molecular dynamics bond angle torsion parameters
search_matrix.required_evidence: Curvature validation and explicit bonded/nonbonded terms

search_matrix.exclusion_criteria: Pure electronic-structure studies without reusable parameters
search_matrix.query: "hydrogen terminated" boron nitride edge B-H N-H force field molecular dynamics
search_matrix.required_evidence: Explicit B-H and N-H charges and bonded terms

search_matrix.exclusion_criteria: Contact-angle fits without published parameter definitions
search_matrix.query: "h-BN water interface" molecular dynamics force field partial charges wettability
search_matrix.required_evidence: Water compatibility, electrostatics and interfacial validation

search_matrix.exclusion_criteria: Parameter sets without B-H or N-H validation
search_matrix.query: boron nitrogen hydrogen reactive force field ReaxFF B N H parameterization
search_matrix.required_evidence: B/N/H training set and validation for bonds and edge chemistry

search_matrix.query: boron nitride edge defect force field parameterization B-H N-H
